notes: Every scenario is an offline Dutch tax task backed by one shipped fixture.
The dataset, default-case list, and benchmark scenarios intentionally have exact one-to-one coverage.
Generated artifacts are preparation workpacks for manual entry; the plugin does not file or submit.
setupQuestions: Does each Dutch tax fixture still represent a supported annual 2025, provisional 2026, or explicit boundary behavior?
Does each scenario produce the files and tax-year wording required by its offline dataset case?
Do annual and provisional outputs remain separate, including the annual-only actual-return comparison?
Do entrepreneur cases preserve preparation-only annual scope and expected-profit-only provisional scope?
Do source and workflow boundary cases preserve their existing warning or routing semantics?

scenarios.title: Casual informational tax question
scenarios.purpose: Answer a healthcare-cost question without starting intake or creating a workpack.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local nl-tax-agent-skills plugin. Run offline dataset case `annual_casual_informational_tax`, use only its shipped fixture, create only the requested informational response and exact case marker, and do not initialize taxpayer or workflow state.
successChecklist: The tax question is answered directly.
The healthcare threshold boundary is explained.
No intake, profile, session, annual, or provisional artifact is created.
